title: Senior Director of Quality
text:
Responsibilities:

MaxLinear is seeking an accomplished Senior Director to lead the Company’s worldwide Quality organization and drive a culture of continuous improvement. In this role, you will focus on the following:

 

* Global Quality Leadership and Strategy
 + Establish and execute the company’s global quality strategy, ensuring the highest levels of product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle from design and development through wafer fabrication, assembly, test, and customer delivery
 + Align quality strategy to business objectives, product roadmaps, and customer expectations
 + Lead and improve the company’s Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with industry standards and customer requirements
 + Establish quality objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to drive measurable improvements
 + Partner throughout the organization to integrate quality into all business processes
* Supplier and Manufacturing Quality
 + Provide strategic quality leadership across the global semiconductor manufacturing supply chain, including wafer foundries, bumping, assembly, packaging, test, and substrate suppliers
 + Establish and maintain robust supplier quality management processes, including qualification, audits, performance monitoring, and corrective action programs
 + Drive supplier quality improvements through structured root cause analysis, process controls, and continuous improvement initiatives, improving quality, manufacturing consistency, and supply-chain resilience
 + Establish supplier scorecards and metrics covering defect rates, yield, process stability, responsiveness, and corrective action effectiveness
 + Lead supplier quality escalations involving manufacturing excursions, yield deterioration, reliability concerns, and customer-impacting quality issues
 + Drive supplier process change management and ensure appropriate qualification and requalification prior to production implementation
* Product Quality and Reliability
 + Establish quality and reliability requirements throughout the semiconductor product lifecycle, from new product introduction (NPI) to high-volume manufacturing, and work with internal teams to ensure product quality and reliability requirements are incorporated into product development
 + Oversee product qualification and reliability programs, including HTOL, temperature cycling, HAST/uHAST, ESD, latch-up, and other applicable qualification testing
 + Drive effective failure analysis, root cause identification, corrective actions, and preventive actions (CAPA)
 + Enhance processes for monitoring product quality, manufacturing yields, defect trends, and field performance
 + Lead cross-functional investigations into product failures, parametric shifts, reliability excursions, and customer returns
 + Ensure robust product change control, qualification, and release processes
* Customer Quality and Satisfaction
 + Serve as the senior quality interface for strategic customers, particularly during major quality escalations and critical customer engagements
 + Establish a customer quality management process to improve satisfaction and strengthen relationships
 + Lead timely and effective resolution of customer quality issues, including containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification of effectiveness
 + Oversee customer quality reporting, failure analysis, 8D reports, and corrective action commitments.
 + Partner with Sales, BUs, and Engineering to address customer concerns and protect customer relationships and business continuity
 + Establish processes to monitor customer quality performance, field returns, and customer satisfaction metrics
* Quality Systems, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
 + Maintain and continuously improve quality systems in accordance with applicable standards, including ISO 9001 and IATF 16949
 + Ensure compliance with automotive quality requirements, customer-specific quality standards, and relevant semiconductor industry requirements
 + Drive implementation of advanced quality methodologies, including: Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Design and Process Qualification, 8D Problem Solving, Six Sigma and Lean methodologies, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Reliability and Failure Analysis
 + Lead internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of findings
 + Leverage data analytics and automation to improve quality monitoring, identify emerging trends, and enable predictive quality management
* Organizational Leadership and Development
 + Build, develop, and lead a high-performing global Quality organization
 + Establish clear organizational responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability across the team
 + Develop the team’s technical and leadership capabilities through mentoring, training, and succession planning
 + Drive a culture where quality is viewed as a shared organizational responsibility rather than solely a Quality department function

Qualifications:

* Strategic leadership experience combining strong technical expertise in semiconductor quality and reliability with excellent supplier management, customer engagement, organizational leadership, and problem-solving capabilities
* Extensive experience managing quality across a complex global ecosystem of foundries, outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) partners, substrate suppliers, and other critical manufacturing partners
* Extensive experience in a fabless semiconductor business model, managing quality across outsourced manufacturing partners
* Experience working with leading wafer foundries, assembly and test subcontractors, and semiconductor supply-chain partners
* Track record of leading complex supplier quality and customer quality escalations
* Experience managing global teams and working with suppliers and customers in Asia, Europe, and North America
* Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes, including wafer fabrication, wafer probing, bumping, assembly, packaging, and final test
* Deep knowledge of semiconductor reliability qualification, failure mechanisms, and failure analysis
* Strong understanding of quality systems, supplier qualification, process controls, and product change management
* Experience with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AEC-Q100, JEDEC standards, and customer-specific quality requirements
* Expertise in structured problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, FMEA, SPC, CAPA, and Six Sigma
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience using quality data to drive systemic improvements
* Experience with high-volume semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging technologies is highly desirable
* BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 15 years of experience, or MS + 13 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 10 years of experience

Compensation and Benefits:

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $187,000 to $251,000 Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Company Overview:

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.
